law.diktatura.richer_than_king: Thou shalt not be richer than the King
law.diktatura.richer_than_king.desc: If your inventory is worth more than 12800 (Upgrader value): arrest, hard labour and 60 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.protect_villagers.desc: Killing a villager or wandering trader: arrest (hard labour and 60 s in a cell) and −20 loyalty.
law.diktatura.state_property: Land near the capital belongs to the State
law.diktatura.state_property.desc: Breaking blocks within 64 blocks of spawn is forbidden. The action is cancelled, fine: 1 emerald.
law.diktatura.no_sedition.desc: Calls to overthrow the Leader or insults in chat: arrest, hard labour and 30 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.no_look_up.desc: The sky belongs to the Leader. Looking up causes temporary blindness.
law.diktatura.curfew.desc: Being outdoors at night is forbidden. Fine: 1 emerald.
law.diktatura.no_tall_houses.desc: Buildings taller than three blocks insult the Leader's palace. The block is not placed.
law.diktatura.no_caps.desc: MESSAGES IN CAPS: 30 seconds of silence and heavy feet.
law.diktatura.no_running.desc: Citizens move with dignity. Runners are slowed down.
law.diktatura.no_sneaking.desc: Whoever sneaks is hiding something. Offenders are highlighted for everyone.
law.diktatura.diamonds_belong_to_state.d: Holding diamonds is forbidden: they are confiscated.
law.diktatura.no_explosives.desc: Carrying TNT or end crystals: confiscation and arrest (hard labour and 30 s in a cell).
law.diktatura.silence.desc: Talking in chat is forbidden today. Every message costs a fine.
law.diktatura.golem_is_police: The golem is a police officer
law.diktatura.golem_is_police.desc: Killing an iron golem is assaulting the police. Arrest: hard labour and 45 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.sacred_cow.desc: Cows are under the Leader's protection. Killing one costs 2 emeralds and a lightning strike.
law.diktatura.no_chicken_punching: The chicken is a national symbol
law.diktatura.no_chicken_punching.desc: Hitting a chicken insults the nation. The hit is cancelled, 20 seconds of timeout.
law.diktatura.protect_flowers.desc: Picking flowers is forbidden. The flower stays, fine: 1 emerald.
law.diktatura.earth_core_is_secret: The deep is a state secret
law.diktatura.earth_core_is_secret.desc: Going below Y=0 is forbidden. Offenders are pushed back up.
law.diktatura.water_is_state_property.de: Swimming without a permit is forbidden. Offenders are weakened.
law.diktatura.helmet_required.desc: Going out without a helmet is forbidden. Fine: 1 emerald.
law.diktatura.no_pumpkin_masks.desc: Wearing a pumpkin hides you from the police. It will be confiscated.
law.diktatura.hunger_is_banned.desc: The country lives in abundance; being hungry is forbidden.
law.diktatura.no_emigration.desc: Leaving the Overworld (Nether or End): arrest, hard labour and 30 s in a cell.
law.diktatura.sleep_is_laziness.desc: Going to bed is forbidden. The lazy get fatigue.
law.diktatura.carrots_for_the_king.desc: Commoners may not eat carrots. All carrots are seized.
law.diktatura.no_ranged_weapons.desc: Bows, crossbows and tridents are seized when used.
law.diktatura.gold_under_kings_feet: Gold is only for the King's feet
law.diktatura.gold_under_kings_feet.desc: Commoners may not stand on gold blocks.
law.diktatura.no_teleporting.desc: Ender pearls and chorus fruit are seized.
law.diktatura.ore_tax.desc: Every mined ore is taxed 1 emerald.
law.diktatura.keep_off_grass.desc: Breaking grass and dirt spoils the Leader's landscape.
diktatura.punish.warning: This is a warning. The Leader sees everything.
diktatura.punish.fine_unpaid: Fine partly paid (%s of %s × %s). Debt recorded: −%s loyalty.
diktatura.punish.timeout: Timeout for %s s: chat is closed, your feet grow heavy.
diktatura.timeout.muted: You may not speak for another %s s.
diktatura.arrest.broadcast: %s has been arrested: "%s". Hard labour, then %s s in a cell.
diktatura.transport.depart: The express wagon is taking you to hard labour!
diktatura.prison.admitted: Labour accepted. You are in a cell, sentence: %s
diktatura.prison.released: Your sentence is over. The wagon will take you back.
diktatura.prison.home: You are free. Five minutes of leniency, then back under watch.
diktatura.loyalty.reward: The Leader is pleased: 2 emeralds and honour.
diktatura.rebellion.start: REBELLION! The people have lost faith. Laws are suspended for %s min (except the fundamental ones).
diktatura.rebellion.end: The rebellion has been crushed. Order is restored.
diktatura.decree.title: Decree No. %s
diktatura.dictator.say.0: The law is harsh, but it is the law. My law. I made it up yesterday.
diktatura.dictator.say.1: I see everything. Especially you. Yes, and that too.
diktatura.dictator.say.2: You may look at me. Not up, though. Looking at the crown costs extra.
diktatura.dictator.say.3: Wealth is a burden. Let me carry it. All of it.
diktatura.dictator.say.4: Our cells are cosy. Three stars on a travel site!
diktatura.dictator.say.5: My next decree will be brilliant. Like the last one. And the one before that.
diktatura.dictator.say.6: Loyalty is the best currency. No change given.
diktatura.dictator.say.7: Freedom? Is that a new block? Ban it just in case.
diktatura.dictator.info: Laws in force: %s. Your loyalty: %s. Next decree in about %s min.
diktatura.hud.returning: The wagon is taking you home
diktatura.book.title: Book of Laws
diktatura.book.subtitle: Laws in force: %s · next decree in %s
diktatura.minigame.parkour.help: Jump your way to the golden platform. The green platform is a checkpoint; if you fall, you restart there.
diktatura.minigame.quarry.help: Mine %s stone with the issued pickaxe. The stone restores itself and drops nothing.
diktatura.minigame.maze.help: Find the way out of the maze: a gold block in the far corner.
diktatura.minigame.done: Labour complete! Now to your cell.
diktatura.event.amnesty.text: The Leader is merciful! Prisoners released: %s
diktatura.event.gifts.text: Every free citizen receives a gift.
diktatura.event.blind_eye.text: By the Leader's order everyone looks with one eye. %s seconds.
diktatura.event.no_gravity.text: The Leader abolishes gravity! %s times for %s seconds. No fall damage.
diktatura.ui.headline.decree: THE LEADER HAS ISSUED A DECREE
diktatura.ui.headline.decree.sub: Decree No. %s takes effect immediately. Ignorance is no excuse.
diktatura.ui.headline.rebellion.sub: Laws are suspended (%s min). The Leader is displeased.
diktatura.ui.rebellion_end.hint: Laws are back in force. Loyalty has been restored by force.
diktatura.ui.test.alert.hint: Alerts work. A report has been filed.
diktatura.ui.test.danger.hint: Flashes red, as the regulations require.
diktatura.ui.wanted.title: WANTED
diktatura.ui.wanted.sentence: Labour duty, then %s s in a cell
diktatura.ui.loading.title: STATE LOADING
diktatura.npc.dictator.info.rebellion: A rebellion is under way. The Leader is taking names.
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.0: I have signed a new decree. Rejoice in an orderly fashion.
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.1: Attention! The laws have changed. Are you breaking them yet?
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.2: My decree is brilliant. It is not up for discussion.
diktatura.dictator.decree_voice.3: Citizens! Read the Book of Laws. That is an order.
diktatura.book.nothing_found: Nothing found. Perhaps it is classified.
diktatura.book.repealed.empty: The Leader has not repealed anything yet. He is always right.
diktatura.book.licenses.empty: No licenses. The Licensing Office will open in a future version. Wait. Patience is a civic duty.
diktatura.dictator.say.8: I'm not a dictator. I'm just a very confident manager.
diktatura.dictator.say.9: Read the Book of Laws? There's a sequel. Came out today.
diktatura.dictator.say.10: Smile. That's not an order. Actually, it is.
diktatura.dictator.say.11: I was elected unanimously. I voted.
diktatura.npc.generic.info: Open to citizens: 24/7. Lunch break: also 24/7.
diktatura.npc.unknown.say: I work here. As what is classified, even from me.
diktatura.cmd.npc.dictator: The Leader has been checked and seated on the throne.
diktatura.dictator.hit.0: That tickles. Guards, process this citizen.
diktatura.dictator.hit.1: Was that a punch? I thought it was a mosquito. Arrest him. The mosquito too.
diktatura.dictator.hit.2: Ow! I mean... not ow. Leaders don't say ow. Arrest!
diktatura.dictator.hit.3: You hit the state. The state is offended.
diktatura.dictator.hit.4: Noting: "attacked the Leader bare-handed". Brave. Stupid, but brave.
diktatura.cmd.throne_rebuilt: The throne hall has been repaired. The bill has been sent to the people.
